mechanism_narrative: A higher CPIAUCSL (as of t-1mo) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated inflation erodes real equity returns and increases the probability of aggressive monetary policy tightening by the Federal Reserve.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 310 and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals an aggressive monetary policy stance that increases the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5.0 and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising UNRATE (unemployment rate) combined with a falling INDPRO (industrial production) signals an imminent recession, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rise > 0.2pp in 1 month AND INDPRO fall > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: UNRATE rise > 0.2pp in 1 month AND INDPRO fall > 0.5% in 1 month and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 310), a federal funds rate above 5.0% signals an aggressive monetary policy that increases the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 310 AND FEDFUNDS > 5.0 and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1200 thousand units combined with residential fixed investment above 700000 million dollars signals a robust housing market, which is a leading indicator of strong economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1200 AND RSAFS > 700000 and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 102.5 (from the 2017=100 base) signals a weakening economy, which increases the probability of recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 102.5 and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher CPIAUCSL (as of t-1mo) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as elevated inflation erodes real equity returns and increases the probability of aggressive monetary policy tightening by the Federal Reserve.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 310 and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals an aggressive monetary policy stance that increases the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5.0 and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
